caption: The drawing consists of several outlined garment pattern pieces arranged on a light beige background with faint yellow-brown edges, resembling aged paper. The pattern pieces are labeled with uppercase letters (A, A1, B, B1, C, D, D1, and E) and placed inside a large rectangular border. There are various shapes, including curved, triangular, and rectangular forms, some of which have notches, dotted lines, or small circles marked. Each piece is annotated with text that describes its function (for example, "CENTER BACK CUT ON FOLD" on piece A). Below the pattern pieces is a block of typed instructions in uppercase letters, describing the assembly process and the roles of each pattern piece. A scale labeled "SCALE 1/8”" appears in the bottom right corner of the rectangular border. The overall composition is monochromatic, using only black ink for drawings and text on the beige-toned paper.
title: Cape (Pattern)
